data.name: Marigold
data.description: Tagetes erecta, the Aztec marigold, Mexican marigold, big marigold, cempaxochitl or cempas\u00fachil, is a species of flowering plant in the genus Tagetes native to Mexico and Guatemala. Despite being native to the Americas, it is often called the African marigold. In Mexico, this plant is found in the wild in the states of M\u00e9xico, Michoac\u00e1n, Puebla, Veracruz and Guerrero.
